description: This Python source file provides utility functions and classes for image processing and object detection, including conversions between PIL and OpenCV images, non-maximum suppression, multi-scale template matching, and drawing bounding boxes. It also defines a Detection data class to represent detection results.

classes.name: Detection
classes.description: Represents an object detection bounding box with position, size, confidence score, and template identifier.

methods.name: np.ndarray pil_to_cv(img: Image.Image)
methods.description: Converts a PIL Image to an OpenCV BGR numpy array, handling alpha transparency by compositing onto white background.

methods.name: bytes cv_to_png_bytes(img_bgr: np.ndarray)
methods.description: Encodes an OpenCV BGR image into PNG format bytes.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,int,int] clamp_rect(x: int, y: int, w: int, h: int, W: int, H: int)
methods.description: Clamps a rectangle's position and size to fit within image boundaries.

methods.name: List[Detection] nms(detections: List[Detection], iou_threshold: float = 0.3)
methods.description: Performs non-maximum suppression on detection boxes based on IoU threshold.

methods.name: List[Detection] multi_scale_template_match( image_bgr: np.ndarray, templates_bgr: List[np.ndarray], match_threshold: float = 0.8, scales: List[float] | None = None, method: int = cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED, )
methods.description: Performs multi-scale template matching to detect templates within an image, returning detection boxes after NMS.

methods.name: np.ndarray draw_boxes(img_bgr: np.ndarray, boxes: List[Detection], color=(0, 0, 255), thickness: int = 2)
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes on an image for visualization.
